headline: Aurobindo Pharma Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about transfer ownership of Auro Pharma LLC, Russia, from Auro Active Pharma Private Limited to Auropharm Overseas Limited, wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company
